Milky Way neighborhood — famous nearby systems at their real galactic (l, b, distance) coordinates through gpos. Every star sits at its honest compressed distance (Proxima 0.042 units, Deneb 26.15) so the chart never lies about who's next to whom — no stars render inside the solar diagram. Marker radii are point-scale glyphs (~0.01–0.05 units, physically a star is far smaller) sized by luminosity class so giants still read bigger than dwarfs; pickability comes from the radius-scaled invisible proxy, not inflated geometry. satellites dress each system with orbiting companions at matching glyph scale.
